name: Rebecca Black
description:
'''Rebecca Renee Black''' (born June 21, 1997) is an American singer, songwriter, [[YouTuber]], and DJ. She gained extensive media coverage when the music video for her 2011 debut single "[[Friday (Rebecca Black song)|Friday]]" went [[viral video|viral]] on [[YouTube]] and various social media sites. The song peaked at number 58 on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]]. It received an overwhelmingly negative response from audiences and music critics, many of whom considered it among the [[List of music considered the worst|worst songs of all time]]. In 2013, Black released a follow-up single "[[Saturday (Rebecca Black and Dave Days song)|Saturday]]" (with [[Dave Days]]) to similar commercial success and marginally improved reception.

Her debut studio album, ''[[Let Her Burn]]'', was released in February 2023 to generally favorable reviews. It was preceded by two [[extended play]]s (EPs); the second, ''[[Rebecca Black Was Here]]'' (2021), marked a change in her sound. In 2025, she released her third EP ''[[Salvation (Rebecca Black album)|Salvation]]''. Her second studio album, ''[[Age of the Exhibitionist]]'', was released on September 4, 2026.
